answer_parts.text: CCTV footage is kept for 31 days as the standard retention period, and is then automatically deleted unless it specifically relates to an ongoing incident, safeguarding concern, or legal matter in which case it may be retained for as long as genuinely relevant to that matter.

Only the registered manager or their deputy are authorised to view footage for a specific, recorded purpose (for example, investigating a reported incident); requests from external bodies are referred to the Data Protection Lead, who confirms the requester’s legal basis before any disclosure, and the Data Protection Lead also audits and advises on access.
